name: Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG
summary: Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG is a German enterprise primarily involved in both automotive manufacturing and financial services. Its core operations include the design, production, and global distribution of vehicles, alongside providing various associated services. Beyond its car business, Porsche AG offers a range of financial solutions, such as financing for both customers and dealerships, leasing arrangements, mobility services, and other related financial products. The company also extends its brand to encompass a selection of accessories and fashion items. Established in 2009, the firm initially operated under the name Porsche Fünfte Vermögensverwaltung AG, before officially adopting its current identity, Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG, in November 2009. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Stuttgart, Germany. Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG functions as a subsidiary of Porsche Holding Stuttgart GmbH.
